164: /**

166:  * then a printing-filtered search (when any printing details are given) or

171: export async function resolveCard(
172:   input: string,
173:   options: ResolveCardOptions = {},
174: ): Promise<ResolvedCard> {

176:   const normalizedInput = normalizeCardName(input);
177:   const cacheKey = buildCacheKey(input, cardSet, finish, variant, collectorNumber);
178:   const cached = getCachedCard(cacheKey);
179:   if (cached) {
180:     return {
181:       scryfallId: cached.scryfallId,
182:       cardName: cached.cardName,

193:   const hasPrintingFilter = Boolean(cardSet || finish || variant || collectorNumber);

195:   if (hasPrintingFilter) {
196:     let query = `!"${input}"`;
197:     if (cardSet) query += ` set:${cardSet.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`;
198:     if (finish) query += FINISH_PREDICATES[finish];
199:     if (variant) query += VARIANT_PREDICATES[variant];
200:     if (collectorNumber) query += ` cn:${collectorNumber.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9Γÿà-]/g, '')}`;

202:       scryfallFetch<{ data: ScryfallCard[] }>(`/cards/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`),
203:     );
204:     card = search?.data?.[0] ?? null;
205:     // Printing-filtered search can be brittle; fall back to a plain fuzzy lookup.
206:     if (!card) {
207:       card = await fuzzyLookup(input);
208:     }
209:   } else {
210:     // With no printing filter, prefer a paper printing over Scryfall's fuzzy
211:     // default, which can land on a digital-only (MTGO/Arena) printing that
212:     // has no real-world market and therefore no Manapool listing.
213:     const paperSearch = await limiter.run(() =>
214:       scryfallFetch<{ data: ScryfallCard[] }>(
215:         `/cards/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(`!"${input}" game:paper`)}`,
216:       ),
217:     );
218:     card = paperSearch?.data?.[0] ?? (await fuzzyLookup(input));
219:   }
220: 
221:   if (card?.name) {
222:     const scryfallId = card.id ?? null;
223:     const cardSetCode = card.set ?? null;
224:     const cardCollectorNumber = card.collector_number ?? null;
225:     const isPaperCard = card.games?.includes('paper') ?? false;
226:     const manapool = isPaperCard && scryfallId ? await lookupManapoolPrinting(scryfallId) : null;
227:     const manapoolUrl = isPaperCard
228:       ? (manapool?.url ??
229:         buildManapoolUrl({

231:           cardSet: cardSetCode,
232:           collectorNumber: cardCollectorNumber,
233:         }))
234:       : null;

237:       cardName: card.name,
238:       cardNameNormalized: normalizeCardName(card.name),

241:       collectorNumber: cardCollectorNumber,
242:       manapoolUrl,

248:       scryfallId: resolved.scryfallId,

251:       cardSet: resolved.cardSet,
252:       cardImageUrl: resolved.cardImageUrl,
253:       collectorNumber: resolved.collectorNumber,
254:       manapoolUrl: resolved.manapoolUrl,
255:       manapoolPriceCents: resolved.manapoolPriceCents,
256:       resolved: true,
257:     });

259:   }
260: 
261:   // Scryfall is unavailable or the card is unknown. Store an unresolved
262:   // fallback so retries are throttled, but still let the listing be created
263:   // with the raw name and no image per the spec.
264:   const fallback: ResolvedCard = {
265:     scryfallId: null,
266:     cardName: input,
267:     cardNameNormalized: normalizedInput,
268:     cardSet: cardSet ?? null,
269:     cardImageUrl: null,
270:     collectorNumber: null,
271:     manapoolUrl: null,
272:     manapoolPriceCents: null,
273:     resolved: false,
274:   };
275:   upsertCachedCard({
276:     cacheKey,
277:     scryfallId: null,
278:     cardName: input,
279:     cardNameNormalized: normalizedInput,
280:     cardSet: cardSet ?? null,
281:     cardImageUrl: null,
282:     collectorNumber: null,
283:     manapoolUrl: null,
284:     manapoolPriceCents: null,
285:     resolved: false,
286:   });
287:   return fallback;

290: function fuzzyLookup(input: string): Promise<ScryfallCard | null> {
291:   return limiter.run(() =>
292:     scryfallFetch<ScryfallCard>(`/cards/named?fuzzy=${encodeURIComponent(input)}`),
293:   );

298: async function loadSetList(): Promise<ScryfallSet[]> {

303:   const sets = data?.data ?? [];

310: /**
311:  * Return set-code autocomplete choices for a partial set name or code.
312:  * Scryfall has no set-search endpoint, so the full set list is fetched once
313:  * and cached in memory, then filtered by prefix/substring match here.
314:  */
315: export async function autocompleteSets(
316:   query: string,
317: ): Promise<Array<{ name: string; value: string }>> {
318:   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
319:   const sets = await loadSetList();
320:   const matches = sets.filter((set) => {
